conclusion.evidence: The norm expansion plus p≥α‖v‖² and ‖d‖²≤βp gives ‖v-hd‖²≤(1-αh)‖v‖². Every multiplication uses h≥0 or a square. The lesson follows exactly this route.

constant_dependencies.evidence: If E is nontrivial, the curvature inequalities imply α≤β. On a singleton, all distances vanish even if αh>1; total sqrt causes no false nonzero-distance conclusion. At β=0 cocoercivity forces equal gradients, making the extra case valid.
